findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SSRF via socket connections
 * @description Socket connections with user-controlled input can lead to SSRF attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/ssrf
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember(["socket", "create_connection"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("asyncio").getMember(["open_connection", "start_server"]).getACall()
select call, "Socket connection that could be vulnerable to SSRF if host/port is user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: SSRF vulnerability via socket connections with user-controlled input

message.text: Socket connection that could be vulnerable to SSRF if host/port is user-controlled.
